newsitem.title: USA: Mesirow Financial adds Boockford insurance firm.
newsitem.headline: Mesirow Financial adds Boockford insurance firm.

text.p: Mesirow Financial on Thursday said it merged Boockford and Co, an Oakbrook Terrace, Ill.-based insurance brokerage firm, into its insurance services division.

Boockford, with 35 employees, provides commercial property and liability coverage, including professional and product liability, employee benefit programs, group and individual life and health insurance and financial planning services.
Mesirow Financial offers private equity, securities brokerage, asset management, insurance services, investment banking and real estate services.
